title: Why Does Metal Feel Cold?
hook: Metal is not always colder than wood.
narration: Metal is not always colder than wood.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Does Metal Feel Cold.
It just steals heat from your fingers fast.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Your skin feels that theft as cold.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
Wood steals heat slowly, so it feels warmer.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Metal is not always colder than wood.
The pictures today are a new rock world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why does metal feel cold.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
